caps.name: digit_classification
caps.description: Classify an 8x8 grayscale handwritten digit image (flattened to 64 pixel values in 0..16) into one of the 10 trained digit classes 0-9.

features.description: Flattened 8x8 image, raw pixel values 0..16 (normalized internally by /16.0)

caps.failure_boundary: Requires exactly 64 numeric values in the 0..16 scale; other lengths or out-of-scale values (e.g. 0..255) yield unreliable or invalid predictions. Only valid for 8x8 load_digits-style inputs; not general images.

caps.name: digit_probability_estimation
caps.description: Return the full class-probability distribution over the 10 digit classes for a 64-dim input, enabling confidence inspection and ranking.

output_schema.description: Mapping of class label string (e.g. '0'..'9') to probability float; values sum to ~1.0

caps.failure_boundary: Same input constraints as predict (64 values, 0..16 scale). Probabilities are softmax outputs from a tiny model and may be overconfident; not calibrated.

caps.name: pixel_saliency_explanation
caps.description: Compute input-gradient saliency for the predicted class and return the top-k most influential pixels, giving a local explanation of the classification.

top_k.description: Number of top influential pixels to return

output_schema.description: Top-k influential pixel entries (e.g. pixel index and/or gradient magnitude), ordered by influence

caps.failure_boundary: Requires a valid 64-dim input and top_k in 1..64; top_k > 64 or < 1 is invalid. Explanation is gradient-based for the predicted class only and inherits any misclassification of predict.

caps.name: class_label_enumeration
caps.description: List the digit class labels the model was trained on, for validating outputs and building probability mappings.
caps.failure_boundary: Static metadata; fails only if frozen weights/state cannot be loaded.
